lab_assumptions: Fixed 25 ms CPU/request, 70% app target, two trusted reads plus four cacheable reads, 500 DB queries/s. These are assumed compatible budgets, not measured throughput or p95.

diagrams.title: Before: one app and local state
diagrams.description: One app serves the current retrieval/draft path; durable jobs and ingestion are retained. Copying its local database to independent hosts would fork authority.

diagrams.title: After: replicas with one durable authority
diagrams.description: Load routing selects ready stateless replicas. Shared DB/current policy remains authoritative; bounded immutable caches reduce byte fetches only. Model dependency capacity remains finite.

diagrams.title: Scaled request sequence
diagrams.description: Route, establish scope, read authority, reuse bytes, persist, respond. A revoked cache hit is blocked; a cold replacement reconstructs state from shared authority.
